style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#334155;fontFamily=Helvetica;spacingTop=2;" value="1. Common 7-step contract: SQS receive -> idempotency lookup -> guard check -> read persisted input -> Bedrock Converse -> TransactWriteItems -> delete.<br/>2. Failure invariance: failed invocation never alters source object or case state; DLQ retains 14 days for idempotent operator redrive.<br/>3. Person screening: ground station screens before upload; person_present moves to S3 restricted/ (KMS restricted, denied to all functions).<br/>4. Region & coded scope: all storage and Bedrock Nova Pro inference run in us-east-1; inf-threshold (D10/B10) is coded in Terraform; drone functions are architecture-only.<br/>5. Dashed lines = error/DLQ, async plausibility, restricted quarantine, or prepared Azure target (not deployed)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="113" width="1882" x="49" y="953" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
1. Common 7-step contract: SQS receive -> idempotency lookup -> guard check -> read persisted input -> Bedrock Converse -> TransactWriteItems -> delete.
2. Failure invariance: failed invocation never alters source object or case state; DLQ retains 14 days for idempotent operator redrive.
3. Person screening: ground station screens before upload; person_present moves to S3 restricted/ (KMS restricted, denied to all functions).
4. Region & coded scope: all storage and Bedrock Nova Pro inference run in us-east-1; inf-threshold (D10/B10) is coded in Terraform; drone functions are architecture-only.
5. Dashed lines = error/DLQ, async plausibility, restricted quarantine, or prepared Azure target (not deployed).
